g.text: Takeaway: mismatched crystals breed threading dislocations — growers use a Ge virtual substrate (e.g. ART) or quantum dots, less sensitive to material defects —

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: yet the 400–600 °C growth still has to fit the CMOS process order.
